spindle.observe.Readiness.title: Readiness
spindle.observe.Readiness.description: The answer of `GET /__spindle/ready`, with or without `--observe` and without the host's thread, beside its status: `200` where the run has no seed or its seed run has ended, a declared refusal among its entries included, and the run is not stopping; `503` while the seed runs, from the moment SIGINT or SIGTERM arrives, and while the run stands by for another process's lease of its PostgreSQL store. A probe reading `200` reads every view holding what the seed's last entry wrote.

stopping.description: Whether the run is stopping on a signal: it answers each request that arrives `503` at once, and the requests already waiting for up to `--drain` seconds.

standby.description: `true` while the run stands by: another `run` process of the same specification holds the lease of a component's tables in the PostgreSQL store, so this one opens no store and answers every request but its own routes `503`, until it takes every lease and leads. Absent otherwise.

spindle.observe.SeedStateKind.title: SeedStateKind
spindle.observe.SeedStateKind.description: Where a served run's seed is. `none`: the run has no seed. `running`: an entry of the seed run under way is left, or the last one's submission has not returned. `ended`: the last entry's submission has returned, so whatever it wrote is in place, whatever each entry became; also from the first request of a start whose `--state` records every entry done.
